**Apply progress: issue-473 — PR #504 cold-review round 1 fixes applied**

Change: issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff. Artifact store: hybrid. Adds to the prior revision (obs #2727): PR #504 (branch feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli) received a cold-review round 1 with 3 confirmed code/test findings + 1 doc residual. All four fixed, gates green, no push.

## Cold-review round 1 fixes (this session)

### Fix 1 (MAJOR) — credential threading, commit 76139b5
`brain/scripts/approve/cli.mjs`: whoami resolved identity via ambient glab CLI session credentials while prView/prReviewComment/prReviews fell back to vcsToken() + hardcoded gitlab.com apiBase inside the provider — two different credential mechanisms; self-hosted GitLab broke entirely, deny-check could evaluate the wrong identity. Fix: import `gitlabApiConfig` from `../vcs/ci-context.mjs`, resolve `const vcsConfig = gitlabApiConfig()` ONCE at the top of `runApprove` (right after `const vcs = await getVcsFn(...)`), spread `...vcsConfig` into all five call sites: `vcs.whoami({ ...vcsConfig })`, both `vcs.prView({ project, number, ...vcsConfig })` calls (compose + anti-stale re-read), `vcs.prReviewComment({ project, number, body, ...vcsConfig })`, `vcs.prReviews({ project, number, ...vcsConfig })`. Mirrors identity.mjs/actor-check.mjs/board.mjs/cold-boot.mjs's `const { apiBase, token, proxyUrl } = gitlabApiConfig()` pattern — harmless no-op params on GitHub. `mrList` call (line ~197) was NOT threaded — out of the 5 confirmed sites, left as-is per delegate scope.
RED proof: new test `REQ-473-CONFIG` in locks.test.mjs asserts every captured call's `{apiBase,token,proxyUrl}` deep-equals the REAL `gitlabApiConfig()` output (not just mutual equality — a naive "all sites equal each other" assertion is red-impossible because pre-fix code passes `undefined` everywhere, which is trivially "equal"). Verified failing against pre-fix cli.mjs via `git stash`, then green after the fix.
Gotcha: putting the literal string `process.env` inside an explanatory CODE COMMENT in cli.mjs breaks the Lock 2 structural test (`count(SOURCE,'process.env') === 0`, unstripped raw source scan) — had to rephrase the comment to avoid the literal substring.

### Fix 2 (MINOR) — behavioral env-bypass test, commit 8b69fb2
`brain/scripts/approve/locks.test.mjs`: added a `BYPASS_ENV` loop (`BRAIN_APPROVE_YES`, `CI`, `YES`, `NONINTERACTIVE`, `BRAIN_NON_INTERACTIVE`) mirroring `brain-promote.locks.test.mjs:133-165` — really sets each var, asserts the prompt still fires (`prompted === 1`, proving liveness not just refusal) and nothing posts. Explicitly documented in the test file and commit body as red-impossible against correct code by construction (cli.mjs already reads process.env zero times per Lock 2) — value is pinning the guarantee forward.

### Fix 3 (MINOR) — site count completeness, commit 8b69fb2 (same commit as Fix 2)
Added two SITE COUNT tests to locks.test.mjs following the existing `vcs.prView(` === 2 shape: `vcs.prReviewComment(` === 1 (guards a future duplicate-post path) and `vcs.whoami(` === 1 (guards a second mid-run identity resolution). Counts verified against POST-Fix-1 code (threading changed call-site shapes via `...vcsConfig` spread, not counts).

### Fix 4 (doc residual, no code) — commit ba1e4eb
Appended one bullet to the "Honest residuals" section of `openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/brain-drafts/adr-0026-amendment-2.draft.md` (right before "### Promotion is manual"): post-then-verify matches the landed body by exact string equality; provider-side whitespace normalization would produce a fail-closed false negative (loud non-zero exit, explicit cleanup instructions, never a silent success) — accepted as the cheaper error over a fuzzy/normalized comparison.

## Commits (chained on 7c17ee7, branch feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli, NOT pushed)
- 76139b5 — fix(vcs): thread gitlab api config through every brain:approve call (#473)
- 8b69fb2 — test(approve): pin env-bypass behavior and add site counts for post/whoami (#473)
- ba1e4eb — docs(adr): record post-then-verify exact-match residual (#473)

## Gates (all green)
- `node --test brain/scripts/approve/cli.test.mjs brain/scripts/approve/locks.test.mjs`: 78/78 pass.
- `npm test`: 2872/2872 pass, 0 fail.
- `npm run repo:check`: PASS.
- `npm run brain:nav`: PASS.
- `.memory/**` left unstaged/uncommitted throughout, no push performed.

## Status
Slice 3 (PR3/PR4) cold-review round 1 findings fully resolved. No new deviations. H.1/H.2 (human-only ADR promotion + re-signing) remain outstanding as before.
